title: Trap a piece
summary: A piece with no safe squares can be trapped and won.

steps.md: A piece with **no safe squares** is trapped. Then you can win it!
The black bishop grabbed a pawn on a2. Can it get out?

steps.explain: Trapped! Your king will eat it.
steps.hint: Close the door with a pawn.

steps.question: A trapped piece is one that…
steps.explain: Every square it can go to is attacked.

steps.md: Pieces on the edge get trapped most often. Keep yours in the middle!
